z-m-24-01.title: Mutsara mumwe wemhinduro wakadzima mhinduro
z-m-24-01.topic: Mhinduro dzinonyangarika kana mativi ose maviri e equation akagovaniswa neexpression imwe chete
z-m-24-01.goal: Wana mutsara upi wemhinduro umo mhinduro yakanyangarika, wedzera mamiriro ema equation umo izvi zvinoitika, uye ugadzire ma equation ako anorasa mhinduro uye utsanangure chikonzero.
z-m-24-01.material: Jia akagadzirisa equation x³ = 4x ndokunyora "mhinduro ndi2 ne−2, mbiri". Doyun akatarisa mhinduro yaJia ndokungoti yakasiyana nemhinduro yake pachake, asina kupa chikonzero. Mubasa iri, x dzose nhamba chaidzo. (x³ inoverengwa se"x cubed" uye x² se"x squared".)
z-m-24-01.thinking.1: Kutonga mamiriro umo kushandura expression kunochinja seti yemhinduro
z-m-24-01.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe amene mienzaniso inopokana (ma equation anorasa mhinduro)
z-m-24-01.prereq.0: H2 mubatch iyi igoverano rekuoma nekutsigira kwerubatsiro uye haireve giredhi rinodzidziswa kuchikoro. Urongwa hwechikoro hunofungidzirwa: wakadzidza kuchikoro chepakati nzira yekugadzirisa ma equation equadratic nekuparadzanisa, uye wakasangana nekuparadzanisa maexpression ecubic muCommon Math.
z-m-24-01.prereq.1: Nzira yekuisa kukosha mu equation kuti uone kana mativi ose maviri akaenzana
z-m-24-01.prereq.2: x dzose mubasa iri nhamba chaidzo.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.prompt: Iyi mhinduro yaJia. Sarudza mutsara wakaita kuti mhinduro ive isina kururama, kana mutsara umo kukanganisa uku kunoonekwa sezvakaita.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumutsara wega wega, ongorora rimwe nerimwe "ndi equation ine mhinduro dzakafanana nemutsara wapfuura pakarepo here?"
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isa 0, 2, −2 pa x nenzira uye uongorore kana equation yepakutanga x³ = 4x inoshanda.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.1: Kugovanisa mativi ose maviri ne x kunopa x² = 4.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.4: Saka mhinduro dze equation iyi ndi2 ne−2, mbiri.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.explain: Mumutsara 2 takagovanisa ne x, asi kana ukaisa x = 0 mu equation yepakutanga, mativi ose maviri i0, saka inoshanda. Nyaya x = 0 haina kutarisirwa zvakaparadzana, saka mhinduro 0 yakasiiwa, uye mugumisiro iwoyo wakaenda ku"mbiri" mumutsara 5. Mitsara 3 ne4 yakagadzirisa zvakarurama equation mushure mekugovanisa. Mhinduro chaidzo dze equation yepakutanga ndedzitatu, −2, 0, 2.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.prompt: Ma equation ose ari pazasi anogadziriswa munhamba chaidzo. Ndeipi isingarasi mhinduro dze equation yepakutanga kunyange kana ukagovanisa mativi ose maviri neexpression yakapihwa mubracket kana mutsananguro uye ukagadzirisa equation yasara chete?
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kune equation yega yega, tsvaga kana pane kukosha kwe x kunoita kuti expression yaunoda kugovanisa nayo ive 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa makosha awakawana mumativi ose maviri e equation yepakutanga, uye utarisewo kana pane equation isina nhamba chaiyo yakadaro zvachose.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.a: Ichi chisarudzo chisina kuongorora kuti mativi ose maviri anova chii kana ukaisa kukosha kunoita x − 2 kuenzana ne0 mu equation yepakutanga.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.b: Wakasiya kuti kukosha kunoita chigovanisi kuva 0 kunogona kuva mhinduro ye equation yepakutanga. Isa x = 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.c: Ichi chisarudzo chakashanda nekushandisa sechiyero kana pane nhamba chaiyo inoita chigovanisi kuva 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.d: Kunyange kana pane square, pakukosha apo x − 1 i0, mativi ose maviri i0. Ongorora kana kukosha ikoko kuri mhinduro.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.explain: Kana mativi ose ane chimiro f·g = f·h, kukosha umo f i0 kuri nguva dzose mhinduro. Saka kana pane nhamba chaiyo umo f i0, unofanira kuchengeta kukosha ikoko zvakaparadzana usati wagovanisa. x² + 3 i3 kana kupfuura kunhamba chaiyo ipi neipi, saka haisi 0 nguva ipi neipi, uye mu c hauraswi mhinduro (x = 4) nekugovanisa. Kana huwandu hwakawedzerwa kunhamba dzakaoma, mhinduro dze x² + 3 = 0 dzinofanira kufungwawo, saka mamiriro akasiyana.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira ma equation 3 akasiyana ane chimiro (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a). a, b, c ma integer kubva pa−9 kusvika pa9 uye c ≠ 0. Ita kuti mhinduro inogovanisa mativi ose maviri ne x − a irase mhinduro imwe, nemhinduro yakarasika a iri yakaipa uye mhinduro b + c inowanikwa mushure mekugovanisa iri yakanaka.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza a kuti ive yakaipa, wobva waedza kuchinja b ne c kuti b + c ive yakanaka.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ongorora zvinoitika kana ukaisa x = a mumativi ose maviri e equation yawakagadzira.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c2: Nhamba dzose nhatu dziri kubva pa−9 kusvika pa9.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c5: Mhinduro b + c inowanikwa mushure mekugovanisa yakanaka.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana a = −3, b = 1, c = 2, ipapo (x + 3)(x − 1) = 2(x + 3). Kugovanisa ne x + 3 kunopa x = 3 chete, asi x = −3 inoitawo kuti mativi ose maviri ave 0, saka imhinduro. Kutamisa zvose kudivi rimwe kunopa (x + 3)(x − 3) = 0, saka mhinduro mbiri, −3 ne3. Ma equation ane mhinduro a nemhinduro b + c inowanikwa mushure mekugovanisa dzakafanana anoverengwa seimwe, saka kana mbiri idzi dzakasiyana, ma equation akasiyana.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.prompt: Sarudza imwe ye equation dzawakagadzira uye unyore kuti mhinduro ipi (nenhamba) inonyangarika kana mativi ose maviri akagovaniswa ne x − a, uye chikonzero.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.0: Verenga kuti divi rega rega rinova chii kana ukaisa x = a mu equation yawakagadzira.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.1: Enzanisa padivi nedivi mhinduro inowanikwa neexpression mushure mekugovanisa nemhinduro inowanikwa nekutamisa zvose kudivi rimwe.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaongorora here nenhamba dziri mumuenzaniso wako kuti kuisa mhinduro inonyangarika mu equation yepakutanga kunoita kuti mativi ose maviri aenzane?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here nemashoko ako chikonzero che"kukosha kunoita chigovanisi kuva 0"?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga here nzira imwe kana kupfuura yekuwana mhinduro dzose usingagovanisi (semuenzaniso, kutamisa zvose kudivi rimwe ndokuita chigadzirwa)?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.0: Expression yandakagadzira i (x+3)(x−1)=2(x+3). Kana ndikagovanisa ne x+3, x=3 chete ndiyo inosara, asi kana ndikaisa x=−3, mativi ose maviri i0, saka −3 imhinduro futi. Ndiko kukosha kunoita chigovanisi kuva 0, saka mhinduro inorasika.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.1: Mu (x+1)(x−4)=−1(x+1), kugovanisa ne x+1 kunopa x−4=−1 chete, ndiko kuti x=3. Asi kana x=−1, x+1 i0 uye mativi ose maviri akaenzana, saka −1 imhinduro futi, uye inonyangarika nokuti zvakafanana nekugovanisa ne0.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Zvakanakawo kuti yakatanga yataura mhinduro inowanikwa mushure mekugovanisa ndokutaura mhinduro yakanyangarika.

z-m-24-02.title: Dambudziko risina muganhu rine mhinduro dzingani?
z-m-24-02.topic: Huwandu hwemhinduro dze equation yecubic x³ = 1 nemuganhu wenhamba
z-m-24-02.goal: Shanda kuti mhinduro inofungidzira muganhu wenhamba upi, chengeta kana kugadzirisa kutonga kwako nezvehuwandu hwemhinduro nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva ruchisvika, uye usimbise nemhinduro inoenderana nemuganhu nemhinduro dzawunowana iwe amene.
z-m-24-02.material: Pane dambudziko rekuwana mhinduro dze equation x³ = 1. Muganhu we x haina kunyorwa mudambudziko. Minsu akanyora mhinduro inoenzanisa ukuru, uye Seoyun, akaona mhinduro, akabvunza, "Hatifaniri kusarudza muganhu kutanga here?" Ruzivo rwunobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva, saka sarudza kutonga kwako nguva imwe neimwe. (x³ inoverengwa se"x cubed".)
z-m-24-02.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kana kuchengeta kutonga neruzivo rutsva
z-m-24-02.thinking.3: Kuwana mhinduro dzakawanda iwe amene uye kuvasimbisa
z-m-24-02.prereq.0: H2 mubatch iyi igoverano rekuoma nekutsigira kwerubatsiro uye haireve giredhi rinodzidziswa kuchikoro. Urongwa hwechikoro hunofungidzirwa: wakatodzidza muCommon Math revo yenhamba dzakaoma (imaginary unit i, i² = −1) nekuwanza kwadzo, discriminant yema equation equadratic, nekuparadzanisa maexpression ecubic.
z-m-24-02.prereq.1: Mamiriro ekuti nhamba mbiri dzakaoma dzive dzakaenzana: zvikamu zvechokwadi zvakaenzana pakati pazvo, uye zvikamu zvekufungidzira zvakaenzana pakati pazvo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga uye utarise kana ruzivo rutsva ruchichinja kana kuchengeta kutonga.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwunobuda, verenga zvakare chisarudzo chawakaita pakutanga uye unyore mumutsara umwe zvakachinja.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.1: Usati wasarudza sarudzo, tanga wataridza "muganhu wenhamba upi" wunofungidzirwa nechisarudzo ichocho.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Iri idambudziko rekugadzirisa equation x³ = 1. Muganhu we x haina kunyorwa mudambudziko. Mhinduro yaMinsu: "x = 1 imhinduro. Kana x > 1 ipapo x³ > 1, uye kana x < 1 ipapo x³ < 1, saka mhinduro imwe chete i x = 1." ('>' inoverengwa se"is greater than" uye '<' se"is less than".)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana x inhamba chaiyo, nharo yaMinsu yakarurama (kana iri hombe pamusoro pe1, x³ > 1, uye kana iri diki, x³ < 1). Asi muganhu haina kunyorwa, saka hatisati taziva kana kufunga nhamba chaidzo chete kwakakwana.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Nhamba dzose dzinogona kuenzaniswa muukuru, saka mhinduro yaMinsu yakarurama uye mhinduro imwe chete i1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Hauna kufunga kana nhamba dzose dzingarongwa seyakakura neyakadiki. Funga kuti nhamba dzipi dzinogona kuenzaniswa muukuru.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Mhinduro yakarurama kana x iri nhamba chaiyo. Asi hapana muganhu, saka kuongorora kwakawanda kuchiri kudiwa
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaverenga kuti mhinduro inofungidzira nhamba dzipi, uye wakasanganisirawo mukutonga kwako kuti muganhu hauna kuvapo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Equation yecubic inofanira kuva nemhinduro nhatu, saka mhinduro inoti ndeimwe chete haina kururama
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakataura huwandu hwemhinduro kubva padhigirii oga. Mhinduro dzakasiyana dzingani dzinofanira kuongororwa nekutarisa expression nemuganhu.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Wakangoisa x = 1, saka hapana chingazivikanwa kubva pamhinduro iyi
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Mhinduro ine chikamu chinofungawo nyaya dzakakura kupfuura 1 nedzakadiki kupfuura 1. Verenga kuti chikamu ichocho chinovimbisa chii.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Ruzivo rutsva rwuviri rwabuda. (1) x³ − 1 = (x − 1)(x² + x + 1), uye discriminant ye equation yequadratic x² + x + 1 = 0 i1 − 4 = −3. (2) Tsananguro iri pamberi pebhuku redambudziko rino inoti "muchikamu chino, ma equation anogadziriswa munhamba dzakaoma", asi dambudziko iri pacharo richiri risina muganhu.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zvino waizopindura sei "pane mhinduro dzakasiyana dzingani"?
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Kubva pa x − 1 = 0 mhinduro chaiyo 1 inobuda, uye x² + x + 1 = 0 ine discriminant yakaipa, saka haina mhinduro chaidzo uye ine mhinduro mbiri dzakasiyana dzekufungidzira. Kana chaiyo, mhinduro 1; kana yakaoma, mhinduro 3. Sezvo muganhu usina kusarudzwa, zvose kupindura nemuganhu, kana kunyora fungidziro inobva patsananguro yechikamu ndokupindura 3, zvine musoro. Kutonga kwaMinsu "munhamba chaidzo pane mhinduro imwe" kunoramba kwakadaro.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Dambudziko haridi muganhu, saka funga nhamba chaidzo chete uye upindure kuti mhinduro i1 chete
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Yakarurama semhinduro mumuganhu wenhamba chaidzo, asi hauna kushandisa ruzivo rutsva, kuverenga discriminant netsananguro yechikamu, mukutonga kwako.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Discriminant i−3, iri yakaipa, saka equation iyi haina mhinduro mumuganhu wenhamba upi noupi
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Discriminant ndeya factor imwe x² + x + 1 chete. Wakanganwa kuti pane imwe factor, x − 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Pindura nekupatsanura muganhu: mhinduro 1 kana chaiyo, mhinduro 3 kana yakaoma
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakaisa chokwadi chekuti muganhu haina kusarudzwa mumhinduro sezvakaita. Kutonga uku kunoratidza kuti mhinduro inoenderana nemamiriro.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Uchitevedza tsananguro yechikamu, itore seyakaoma uye unyore 3, uchitaura fungidziro
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakashandisa chikomborero chetsananguro yechikamu uye wakataura fungidziro. Kutonga uku kwakanyora hwaro nemuganhu.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Taura kuti mudzi mumwe wekufungidzira ω = (−1 + √3 i)/2. (i ndiyo imaginary unit ine i² = −1, uye expression inoverengwa se"minus 1 plus root 3 i, over 2".) Tinoziva kuti ω imudzi we x² + x + 1 = 0. Tinoda kuongorora zvakananga kana ω iyi inogutsawo x³ = 1 chaizvo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Nzira dzekuongorora dzipi dzakarurama? (Pangava nenzira dzakawanda.)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Nzira mbiri dzose dzekuongorora dzakarurama. a inoshandisa ω² + ω + 1 = 0 chete, uye c inowana ω² zvakananga ndokuwanza. Kukosha kwakatarwa (b) kuongorora kunobata kukanganisa kuverenga chete uye hakusimbisi, uye d inofungidzira mhedziso pamberi. Sezvo mudzi wekufungidzira ugutsawo x³ = 1 nenzira iyi, kutonga kwekare kwekuti pane mhinduro 3 munhamba dzakaoma kunotsigirwa.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Shandisa ω² = −ω − 1 kuverenga ω³ = ω·ω² = −ω² − ω = 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakasarudza nzira yekudzikisa ω³ kuita expression yakananga mu ω uchishandisa expression yauri kuziva kare.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Nyora ω se −0.5 + 0.87i, wanza kakawanda, uye utore kuti yaongororwa kana iri padhuze ne1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kuverenga nemakosha akatarwa kunobatsira sekuongorora, asi hakusimbisi kuti i1 chaizvo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wana ω² uye uiwanze ne ω kuti uongorore kuti (−1+√3 i)(−1−√3 i)/4 = 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakasarudza nzira yekuongorora nekuwanza zvakananga. Kiyi ndeyekuti chikamu chekufungidzira chinonyangarika sei.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Sezvo ω imudzi we equation yakati, tora ω³ = 1 seyatoshanda uye uishandise sezvayakaita
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakafungidzira kuti mhedziso yaunoda kuongorora yatova yechokwadi. Equation iyo ω iri mudzi wayo i x² + x + 1 = 0, kwete x³ = 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.reflect: Kana wakatanga wafunga kuti "mhinduro imwe chete i1", ruzivo rupi rwakaderedza kutonga uku kuita "kwakarurama munhamba chaidzo"? Nei nharo inoenzanisa ukuru isingagone kushandiswa kunhamba dzekufungidzira?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira nhamba yakaoma z = a + bi (a, b nhamba chaidzo) inogutsa z³ = 1. Sezvo (a + bi)³ = (a³ − 3ab²) + (3a²b − b³)i, chikamu chechokwadi a³ − 3ab² chinofanira kuva 1 uye chikamu chekufungidzira 3a²b − b³ chinofanira kuva 0. Isa mhinduro 3 dzakasiyana se (a, b). Nhamba dzisina kuverengeka dzinogona kunyorwa dzakatenderedzwa kunzvimbo mbiri dzedhesimali, uye kukanganisa mukati me0.02 kunogamuchirwa.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ongorora kuti x³ − 1 inova chii kana ukaisa z = 1, uye uwane midzi yeexpression yequadratic yasara x² + x + 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.1: Isa chikamu chechokwadi chemudzi wawakawana mu a uye nhamba iri pamberi pe i mu b, uye uverenge kana maexpression maviri ari padhuze ne1 ne0, nenzira.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Chikamu chechokwadi chinoenderana ne1 (mukati mekukanganisa kwe0.02).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Chikamu chechokwadi a³ − 3ab² che (a + bi)³ hachisi 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Chikamu chekufungidzira chinoenderana ne0 (mukati mekukanganisa kwe0.02).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Chikamu chekufungidzira 3a²b − b³ che (a + bi)³ hachisi 0.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.explain: Mhinduro ndedzitatu, z = 1, z = (−1 + √3 i)/2, z = (−1 − √3 i)/2. Sema decimal ndeanenge (1, 0), (−0.5, 0.87), (−0.5, −0.87). Mhinduro imwe chete yakanyorwa nenhamba dzakasiyana shure kwedhesimali haiverengwi semhinduro yakasiyana. Mhinduro chete ine chikamu chekufungidzira 0 i1, uye nekuenzanisa ukuru oga haugone kuwana mhinduro mbiri dzimwe.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora kuti nei nharo yaMinsu yekuti "kana iri hombe pamusoro pe1, x³ > 1, uye kana iri diki, x³ < 1" isingagone kuwana midzi yekufungidzira, uye kuti pane mhinduro dzakasiyana dzingani mumuganhu wenhamba chaidzo nemumuganhu wenhamba dzakaoma.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Taura kuti nhamba dzipi dzinofungidzirwa pane 'x > 1' kana 'x < 1' paiswa munharo yaMinsu.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Patsanura kuita muganhu wenhamba chaidzo nemuganhu wenhamba dzakaoma uye uverenge mhinduro dzawakawana kare mumwe nemumwe.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora here nemashoko ako kuti nharo yaMinsu inovimba ne"nhamba dzipi dzinogona kuenzaniswa muukuru"?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here zvose huwandu hwemhinduro mumuganhu wenhamba chaidzo nehwemuganhu wenhamba dzakaoma?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakafunga here nezvemidzi yekufungidzira uchiibatanidza nemakosha awakawana pamusoro (chikamu chechokwadi −0.5 nezvimwewo)?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Mhinduro yaMinsu yakarurama chete kana x iri nhamba chaiyo. Ukuru hunogona kuenzaniswa pakati penhamba chaidzo chete, uye nhamba dzekufungidzira hadzigoni kurongwa nekukura, saka midzi yekufungidzira haigoni kuwanikwa nenzira iyi. Mumuganhu wenhamba chaidzo pane mhinduro 1, uye mumuganhu wenhamba dzakaoma pane 3.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Mumuganhu wenhamba dzakaoma, nharo yaMinsu haigoni kushandiswa. Nhamba dzekufungidzira hadzina hombe kana diki, saka haugone kufunga nezviratidzo zvekusaenzana. Kana chaiyo, pane imwe (1), uye kana yakaoma, pane nhatu: 1 nemidzi miviri yekufungidzira.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Yakataura mamiriro ekuenzanisa ukuru neizwi rekuti "haugone kufunga nezviratidzo zvekusaenzana".
